name: blender
instruction: Blender is a 3D application. IMPORTANT: Blender renders its entire UI with OpenGL custom fonts. click_text WILL NOT WORK on any Blender UI element. BLENDER DOES NOT USE Alt+key MENUS like Windows apps. CORRECT SHORTCUTS: Ctrl+O=Open file dialog, Ctrl+N=New file, Ctrl+S=Save, Ctrl+Shift+S=Save As, F3=Search any command (type the command name e.g. 'Open Recent'). OPENING A SPECIFIC FILE: Use cmd action to launch blender with the file path directly: {"type": "cmd", "command": "& 'C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.2\blender.exe' 'C:\path\to\file.blend'"}. SPLASH SCREEN: To open a recent file from the splash, use coordinate click based on the grid. Click outside splash to dismiss. MODELING SHORTCUTS: Tab=Edit/Object mode, Shift+A=Add menu, G=Move, R=Rotate, S=Scale, X=Delete, Ctrl+Z=Undo, Numpad0=Camera, F12=Render. NAVIGATION: Middle-mouse=Orbit, Scroll=Zoom, Shift+Middle=Pan. N-PANEL (Sollumz tools): Press N key. CRITICAL: For ANY Blender UI interaction, use coordinate-based click (with the grid) or keyboard shortcuts. NEVER use click_text.
